variants.label: Family-typed record IR
variants.representation_shape: One addressable record kind per normative family (eight kinds) sharing a common envelope {source_anchor, family, evidence_class, verdict}; a family payload carries only that family's content; a separate link record connects provision anchors to family records. Family identity is a type boundary, so a missing family is a missing record, not an absent field.
variants.separation_rationale: Every one of the eight families owns a distinct record kind, so obligation, permission, prohibition, definition, competence, condition, exception and temporal qualification cannot share one addressable slot; merging two families would require a deliberate second record kind rather than a field default.

provision_to_rule.unknown_policy: A provision with no family record yields Unknown for that provision: the absence of a record is the absence of evidence, never the statement that no norm exists.

rule_to_provision.unresolved_policy: A family record without at least one resolved provision anchor is unresolved and cannot be emitted as a resolved link.

what_it_cannot_prove: It cannot prove the legal correctness of a family classification, a record payload or a reading: separation is a structural property, not a legal conclusion.
It cannot prove that the eight record kinds exhaust every normative distinction that a source provision carries.
It cannot prove that two records anchored to the same provision describe one norm; that composition stays a later decision.
variants.consequences_for_S03: S03 would have to mint and validate eight record kinds plus the envelope and the link record, and would have to define Condition, Exception and Defeater in section 3 before any family payload can carry a guard or a defeat.
collapse_risks: A ban reading and a missing duty can both be filed under the prohibition kind when the classifier prefers a ban, so absence_of_obligation could be recorded as prohibition at classification time.
A definition kind and an obligation kind can anchor the same provision text, so the two records can be read as one norm unless the link record forbids it.
variants.required_new_adr_terms_note: Per-family records still need a guard role for the condition family and a defeat role for the exception family; those three section 3 rows are deferred-undefined today. The NormRule row itself does not have to be defined because this variant mints no composite rule record.
variants.compatibility_with_existing_vocab: The existing ln-applicability NormRule spine (RC11-F04a) carries id, revision, conditions, exceptions, defeaters and a temporal scope as structural design types; this variant reuses none of them and mints eight new record kinds, so nothing is duplicated but nothing is reused either, and S02 must agree that the spine stays unreferenced.
variants.cost_and_risk: Highest structural cost: eight record kinds, one envelope and one link record must each be specified and validated, and three section 3 rows must be defined first. Risk: kind proliferation makes cross-family comparison harder and invites a ninth kind when a provision fits none of the eight.
variants.recommendation_rationale: It separates all eight families at the strongest boundary, but it is the largest new ADR surface and still needs three deferred section 3 rows, so it is offered as a structural reference rather than as the smallest next step.

variants.label: Single facet-slot rule record
variants.representation_shape: One NormRule-like record kind whose family content lives in typed facets: deontic_operator, definition_scope, competence_source, condition_guard, exception_defeater_list, temporal_qualification. Family identity is a facet value inside one record, so the eight families are distinguishable by field but share one addressable record and one provenance bundle.
variants.separation_rationale: Seven families own a dedicated facet with its own closed value set. Definition is carried as a definition_scope facet of the same record, so a definitional norm is not independently addressable and the definition/rule boundary is not type-enforced.

provision_to_rule.unknown_policy: A rule record whose deontic_operator facet cannot be resolved from any provision anchor yields Unknown for that facet; an absent facet is never a default permission and never a default prohibition.

rule_to_provision.unresolved_policy: A rule record needs at least one resolved provision anchor; a rule whose anchors are all unresolved stays unresolved and is not emitted as resolved.

what_it_cannot_prove: It cannot prove the legal correctness of a facet value or of a composed rule: one record with facets is a representation, not an adjudication.
It cannot prove that a missing facet is a deliberate absence rather than an unrecorded family; facet defaults are exactly where a silent collapse can hide.
It cannot prove that facet values on one record describe a single norm rather than several norms that share an anchor.
variants.consequences_for_S03: S03 would extend the existing ln-applicability NormRule spine with a deontic operator, a definition scope and a competence source, and would have to define all six normative section 3 rows; facet-default policy and composition would be the first runtime surface to fail-closed.
collapse_risks: A definition can be absorbed into the definition_scope facet of an obligation record, so definition and obligation can be read as one norm.
An absent deontic_operator facet can default to permission or to prohibition, collapsing absence_of_obligation into prohibition in the same way RC28-F18 warns about.
variants.required_new_adr_terms_note: The record is a NormRule, so the NormRule row has to be defined, and its facets pull in Condition, LegalEffect, Exception, Defeater and ApplicabilitySelector. This is the largest section 3 surface of the three variants.
variants.compatibility_with_existing_vocab: Closest to the existing ln-applicability NormRule spine (RC11-F04a): conditions maps onto condition_guard, exceptions and defeaters onto exception_defeater_list, and the temporal scope onto temporal_qualification. The deontic operator, definition scope and competence source have no existing field, so this variant extends the spine instead of duplicating it, but the extension still requires the deferred section 3 rows.
variants.cost_and_risk: Moderate structural cost, concentrated in facet semantics rather than record kinds. Risk: one record kind makes an unrecorded family look like an absent field, so every facet default has to be fail-closed and explicit before any runtime work.
variants.recommendation_rationale: It reuses the closest existing design spine and keeps rule composition in one place, but it needs all six deferred terms and its facet defaults are the easiest place for a silent collapse, so it is not the smallest safe first step.

variants.label: Abstention-first candidates only
variants.representation_shape: No composed rule is emitted. Each source-bound candidate carries a family classification, a source anchor and a verdict from {Unknown, Conflict}; composition, facet defaults and applicability evaluation are not performed, and NormRule stays deferred-undefined.
variants.separation_rationale: A candidate carries its family as an explicit classification, so the eight families stay distinguishable at the candidate level; nothing is composed, so no family boundary has to be enforced inside a rule record.

provision_to_rule.unknown_policy: A provision with no candidate yields Unknown for that provision, which is exactly the abstention outcome: absence of provenance is never the statement that no norm exists.

rule_to_provision.unresolved_policy: A candidate without at least one resolved anchor is unresolved and cannot be presented as a resolved classification.

what_it_cannot_prove: It cannot prove the legal correctness of a family classification or the absence of a norm: it produces candidates and Unknown outcomes, not conclusions.
It cannot prove rule composition, precedence, exception defeat or case applicability, because no rule is composed.
It cannot prove that the emitted candidate set is complete for a provision.
variants.consequences_for_S03: S03 would build only candidate emission and the fail-closed Unknown or Conflict verdicts, and would not touch rule composition, facet defaults or applicability; the deferred section 3 rows stay deferred and a later ADR decides composition separately.
collapse_risks: A classified candidate can be read as a composed rule that already settles the case, so the artifact must keep stating that classification is not composition.
An absent candidate can be read as a negative finding, collapsing lack_of_evidence into falsity.
variants.required_new_adr_terms_note: Empty on purpose: NormRule and the other section 3 deferred terms stay deferred-undefined because no rule is composed and no facet is defaulted. That is this variant's main virtue, and it is also its main limitation, because nothing about composition is decided.
variants.compatibility_with_existing_vocab: It does not touch the existing ln-applicability NormRule spine (RC11-F04a) at all; the spine stays an unreferenced structural design until a later ADR decides composition. No existing field is duplicated and no new normative term is minted.
variants.cost_and_risk: Lowest structural cost and the smallest new vocabulary: candidate classification plus Unknown and Conflict outcomes. Risk: the deferral of composition is real work postponed, and a later composition ADR will have to reopen the section 3 rows anyway.
variants.recommendation_rationale: It is the only variant that defines no new section 3 term and composes nothing, so it is the smallest contour that can lie: it can be adopted, bounded and fail-closed without promoting RC28-F18 semantics. The recommendation is advisory and is not the owner's decision.

link_record_form.from: provision anchor identifier (repository-relative tracked anchor or a declared corpus-gated anchor reference)
link_record_form.to: family record, rule record or candidate identifier of the chosen variant
link_record_form.family: exactly one of the closed eight family ids

source_anchor.path: repository-relative tracked path, or a declared corpus-gated path
source_anchor.span: byte span [start,end), or the explicit marker unresolved
source_anchor.sha256: sha256 of the anchored artifact, or the explicit marker unresolved

non_claims: A link record is design data, not a runtime object and not a legal conclusion.
A resolved link proves that an anchor exists and matches, never that the classification is legally correct.

rules.statement: Absence of provenance yields Unknown; it never means that no rule exists.
An unresolved static anchor yields verdict unresolved, never a resolved link and never a silent omission.
Two anchors that contradict each other yield verdict conflicted, never a majority pick and never a silent preference.
Silent collapse of the declared N to M cardinality, for example folding many provisions into one rule without a link record, is forbidden and is reported with the code cardinality_collapsed.

non_claims: This contract is a declared shape for provenance links, not an accepted schema and not a runtime validator.
It does not prove that any provision-to-rule link is resolvable in the current corpus.

decision_question.question: Which normative IR alternative should the owner adopt for the bounded normative IR: A family_typed_record_ir, B single_facet_slot_rule_record, or C abstention_first_candidates_only? The owner may also reject all three or defer the decision; no option is preselected and no answer is assumed here.
decision_question.chat_answer_is_not_adoption: An answer in chat is not an ADR, not a Review Case event and not an authorization to implement: it records a direction that a separate adoption step must still carry.

recommendation_summary.rationale: All three variants are source-bound and none is adopted. The recommendation names abstention_first_candidates_only because it requires no new section 3 term and composes no rule, which keeps the next step inside the deferred-undefined boundary that RC28-F18 and TSG-005 already declare. A recommendation is not an adoption, and the decision question stays open for the owner in S02.

non_claims: This artifact is not an adoption of normative semantics: no variant, cardinality or reading below is accepted.
It is non-authoritative: it cannot satisfy a requirement, promote a lifecycle, close a gap row or establish legal correctness.
No runtime surface exists or is promised: no normative IR, no rule graph and no applicability evaluator is created here.
The recommendation is advisory only and is not the owner's decision.
The N to M cardinality is a declared contract shape, not evidence that any provision-to-rule link is proven.
Section 3 is unchanged: the deferred terms stay deferred-undefined and no new row is minted.
revision_policy: Re-derive before use: S02 must re-hash every source_binding path, re-read the section 3 and gap-register statuses, and re-bind this artifact before showing it; no timestamp and no aggregate engine hash are stored here.
